mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen for three consecutive weeks from -79.7 to -77.1, indicating a steady upward mobility trend that will continue over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved from -79.7 at t-3w to -77.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES crossing above -65% signals that lockdown policy has eased enough for commuting to resume, which lifts weekday retail footfall over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES exceeds -65.0 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose to -64.7 at t-0w from -69.4 at t-3w
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES is above -65.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of TRANSIT rising above -74% and PARKS falling below 0% indicates a shift from outdoor-only mobility to mixed mobility including retail, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved to -73.0 while PARKS fell to -3.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: When TRANSIT > -74.0 and PARKS < 0.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not higher than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a residential-retreat regime where RESIDENTIAL falls below +28% while GROCERY_PHARM remains less negative than -30%, people are leaving home for non-essential errands, raising RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined to +26.7 and GROCERY_PHARM improved to -29.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL < 28.0 and GROCERY_PHARM > -30.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM remaining below -25% signals persistent precautionary shopping and reduced discretionary trips, which will keep RETAIL_REC depressed over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM remains below -25.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of WORKPLACES below -60% and RESIDENTIAL above +25% indicates that work-from-home policy remains binding, suppressing commuter retail over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is -64.7 and RESIDENTIAL is +26.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES < -60.0 and RESIDENTIAL > 25.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: A PARKS reading above +5% in spring indicates outdoor recreation substituting for retail trips, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next week after such a spike.
candidate_trigger: PARKS exceeds +5.0 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: When PARKS exceeds +5.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not lower than its mean over the last 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing above -74% signals that enough residents have resumed travel for retail activity to recover, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT exceeds -74.0 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: When TRANSIT exceeds -74.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not higher than over the last 7 days.
